basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and long-time member of the Reddit community, I hail from the Midwest, USA. With a keen interest in online RPGs, particularly Red Dead Online and Lineage 2M, I love exploring virtual worlds and strategizing with fellow gamers. By day, I work as a software developer, specializing in game design, which allows me to merge my passion with my profession. When I'm not gaming, you might find me painting miniatures, a hobby I picked up about five years ago. I'm single and usually online during the evenings, especially active on weekends. I enjoy engaging in discussions about game mechanics and sharing tips with fellow enthusiasts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise primarily lies in game mechanics and design, honed through a combination of formal education in computer science and years of avid gaming. I've developed several mods for popular games, which has deepened my understanding of game dynamics and coding.
